
### HTTP: HyperText Transfer Protocol  {.smaller}


* primary application-layer protocol for the Web
  - introduced in 1991
  - version 1.1 in 1997, version 2 in 2015, version 3 in 2022
* standard ports: 80 (non-encrypted), 443 (encrypted)
* uses TCP (or TCP + TLS for encrypted version)

### HTTP: HyperText Transfer Protocol  {.smaller}

* <code>http://www.foo.com/bar</code>
* resolve "server" www.foo.com via DNS
* send "request" to server like:
```
GET /bar HTTP/1.1
Host: www.foo.com
...
```
* receive "response" like
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html
...

<html>...
```
* status code (200 in example) indicates error or not
   * 200 OK, 403 Unauthorized, 404 Not Found, 500 Internal Server Error, …
* headers (key/value pairs) for metadata on request + responses

### HTTP methods {.smaller}


* GET --- get resource
* POST --- sending forms
* HEAD --- get metadata about file (without getting its data)
* PUT, DELETE, …
